name: Xiaomi Mi Box 3
summary: Xiaomi Mi Box 3 ships with PatchWall rows, promos and telemetry. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Xiaomi Mi Box 3 is a streaming box on Android TV 9 with 2 GB of memory. It ships with Xiaomi and Google telemetry and ad tracking, the PatchWall home with content rows, promos and auto-installs, and preloaded apps. Voice, Mi cast and the phone remote are off by choice.

Everything else stayed off after a restart, and the new home screen stayed Home. Home and Back work without any key helper. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything. Each app has its own switch.
keep: Firmware updates and their download helper
The setup helper, which owned a saved Wi-Fi network
Xiaomi setup and TV service parts
notes: Turning off the voice assistant stops the mic button.
The Ambient screensaver is turned back on at every start. It is harmless once the screensaver points at the new home screen's clock.
It has no HDMI input or tuner.

faq.q: Will the mic button still work?
faq.a: Not if you switch off the voice assistant, which is on the list as a personal choice. Leave it on to keep voice.

faq.q: Does it have a way back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on in one tap, and puts the old home screen back if you changed it.
